mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) combined with prochlorperazine (antipsychotic) can cause serotonin syndrome, hypertensive crisis, and severe CNS depression through monoamine potentiation and additive effects on sympathomimetic pathways.
action: Avoid this combination; MAOIs are contraindicated with typical antipsychotics due to risk of hypertensive crisis and serotonin syndrome; if antipsychotic therapy is essential, use only under specialist supervision with close monitoring of blood pressure and vital signs.
